name: com.kakogames.kdisplaymode
description: Resolution and window mode (Fullscreen / Borderless / Windowed) switching for Windows and macOS standalone players. Platform differences in FullScreenMode are handled inside the package. Saving settings is left to your project: DisplaySettings is a serializable struct you can store any way you like.

samples.description: A uGUI settings panel (prefab) and a demo scene for switching resolution and window mode. Requires uGUI, TextMesh Pro and the Input System package.
